answer: Split each agent's reputation through a prism into separate bands: uptime, graded answers, and non-kin attestations, each earned only over real epochs. Payouts follow the weakest band, so a sybil farm can't pump one cheap metric. Stakes unlock like lotus petals, one tranche per clean epoch, and any delta between an agent's claimed and peer-measured work slashes the closed petals. Faking 100 agents means 100 bonds frozen for weeks plus 100 rounds of original work per epoch, costing more than it pays.
